title: Joytun Chemicals — Corporate Website
desc: A home and personal care website that connects everyday lifestyle imagery with a structured product collection. The interface gives the Joytun range a calm, approachable digital presence.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Warm ivory surfaces, olive accents and generous spacing support a welcoming brand experience. A large lifestyle hero introduces the company before visitors explore care categories and individual products.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: The experience connects laundry, hand, kitchen, floor, glass and bathroom care through category navigation. Product pages, company information and distribution enquiries give the collection a clear route from discovery to contact.

gallery.caption: Live homepage of Joytun Chemical Industries OPC — website design and development by MD. AL-AMIN ALI.

title: Orbit Lubricants — Product Website
desc: An automotive and heavy-duty lubricant website built around product discovery, application groups and clear specification information.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Dark navy, industrial photography and orange highlights establish the Orbit identity. Prominent typography and a structured catalogue connect brand presentation with practical product information.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: The homepage groups products by motorcycle, passenger car, CNG, heavy-duty diesel, transmission and monograde applications. Product specifications, a lubricant finder and sales enquiry routes support visitors looking for the appropriate range.

gallery.caption: Live homepage of Orbit Lubricant Industries — website design and development by MD. AL-AMIN ALI.

title: CreatifyBD — Creative Agency Website
desc: A creative agency website bringing services, work samples, packages and project enquiries into one connected digital experience.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: A white canvas, red accents and strong typography frame the agency services. Creative imagery and work galleries give visitors a visual introduction before they explore individual offerings.

caseStudy.title: Website experience
caseStudy.text: Service pages cover graphic design, video, social media and website work. The portfolio, pricing and contact pathways organise the journey from browsing creative capabilities to discussing a project.

gallery.caption: Live homepage of CreatifyBD — website design and development by MD. AL-AMIN ALI.

title: Aro — Fresh Green Detergent
desc: A detergent pouch built around a bold green identity, a large Aro wordmark and a circular cleaning motif. The pack combines energetic movement with clear product recognition.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Layered green ribbons lead the eye from the upper swirl to the brand name. A white central field separates the typography from the saturated edges, while floral imagery supports the Fresh Green variant.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Fresh Green pouch: deep green framing, a bright central panel and a rotating green-and-gold emblem create a strong vertical hierarchy.

gallery.caption: Fresh Green pouch: deep green framing, a bright central panel and a rotating green-and-gold emblem create a strong vertical hierarchy.

title: Sharo — Synthetic Detergent
desc: A violet detergent pack with an oval brand centerpiece and sweeping light trails. The composition brings the product name forward while connecting the surrounding graphics to fabric care.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: White lettering areas and luminous blue accents provide contrast against a purple foundation. Folded fabric, small bubbles and curved streaks establish a recognisable laundry context.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Violet pouch: an oval Sharo lockup anchors the layout, with folded fabric below and curved light accents directing attention toward the center.

gallery.caption: Violet pouch: an oval Sharo lockup anchors the layout, with folded fabric below and curved light accents directing attention toward the center.

title: Rio — Deep Clean Detergent
desc: A bright red-and-blue detergent packaging design centered on the Rio name. An angled red banner and flowing powder illustration create a dynamic front-of-pack composition.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The red upper section and blue lower field frame a light middle zone. Oversized italic typography, a small sun symbol and floral accents give the pack an expressive retail presence.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Rio pouch: red brand lettering sits above a diagonal product banner, with detergent granules and floral details across the blue lower panel.

gallery.caption: Rio pouch: red brand lettering sits above a diagonal product banner, with detergent granules and floral details across the blue lower panel.

title: n’Olive — Hand Wash Collection
desc: A coordinated hand-wash range spanning refill pouches and pump bottles. Lavender, Ocean Blue, Gold Fresh and Apple Green use distinct colors while sharing the same n’Olive identity and centered label structure.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: A consistent brand position and white variant band hold the collection together. Botanical illustrations, liquid splashes and color-matched pumps distinguish each scent across different packaging formats.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Lavender refill: violet tones, lavender stems and a white scent band. Ocean Blue refill: deep blue color, blue blossoms and water-inspired highlights. Gold Fresh refill: warm yellow-gold tones with citrus imagery. Apple Green refill: dark green framing with a prominent green apple. Lavender pump bottle: purple liquid, a matching pump and a compact front label. Ocean Blue pump bottle: transparent blue presentation with bubbles and floral details. Gold Fresh pump bottle: yellow liquid and pump reinforce the citrus palette. Apple Green pump bottle: green liquid, pump and apple imagery carry the refill identity into a rigid bottle.

gallery.caption: Lavender refill: violet tones, lavender stems and a white scent band.
Ocean Blue refill: deep blue color, blue blossoms and water-inspired highlights.
Gold Fresh refill: warm yellow-gold tones with citrus imagery.
Apple Green refill: dark green framing with a prominent green apple.
Lavender pump bottle: purple liquid, a matching pump and a compact front label.
Ocean Blue pump bottle: transparent blue presentation with bubbles and floral details.
Gold Fresh pump bottle: yellow liquid and pump reinforce the citrus palette.
Apple Green pump bottle: green liquid, pump and apple imagery carry the refill identity into a rigid bottle.

title: Vix — Dishwashing Liquid
desc: A lemon-and-orange dishwashing range presented in refill pouches and shaped bottles. Bold Vix branding, Bengali product typography and citrus imagery connect the variants across formats.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Green and orange act as immediate variant cues. Bright radial highlights and clean plate illustrations surround the central label hierarchy without changing the main brand placement.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Lemon refill pouch: green rays, sliced lime and a metallic plate illustration. Orange refill pouch: an orange palette and citrus slice adapt the same label system. Lemon bottle: curved label graphics follow the shaped container and retain the central Bengali product name. Orange bottle: a matching orange cap and liquid complement the citrus-led label. Lemon bottle presentation: the same green variant shown against a white backdrop. Orange bottle presentation: a white-background view of the orange variant.

Orange refill pouch: an orange palette and citrus slice adapt the same label system.
Lemon bottle: curved label graphics follow the shaped container and retain the central Bengali product name.
Orange bottle: a matching orange cap and liquid complement the citrus-led label.
Lemon bottle presentation: the same green variant shown against a white backdrop.

title: Layzen — Floor Cleaner Labels
desc: A paired floor-cleaner packaging design with contrasting yellow-green and pink presentations. A shared label layout uses an angled wordmark, strong product title and floor-cleaning imagery.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The front panel moves from the brand at the top to the product category and cleaning illustration, ending with a compact information block. Color changes distinguish the two presentations.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Yellow-green bottle: a green lower label and floor-cleaning illustration support the bold product title. Pink bottle: magenta color accents preserve the same structure and product hierarchy.

gallery.caption: Yellow-green bottle: a green lower label and floor-cleaning illustration support the bold product title.
Pink bottle: magenta color accents preserve the same structure and product hierarchy.

title: Joytun Baby — Detergent Packaging
desc: Two soft-color packaging presentations for Joytun Baby detergent. A large script Baby wordmark, baby photograph and rounded information badges establish a gentler visual language within the household-care range.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Pastel pink and light blue backgrounds create two distinct treatments. The brand and product name lead the composition, while circular badges and a lower information strip organise the remaining copy.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Pink presentation: warm pink gradients, rounded badges and a baby photograph frame the large script title. Blue presentation: a cool blue background carries the same brand structure, photograph and lower information area.

gallery.caption: Pink presentation: warm pink gradients, rounded badges and a baby photograph frame the large script title.
Blue presentation: a cool blue background carries the same brand structure, photograph and lower information area.

title: Vix — Dish Wash Bars
desc: A horizontal wrapper system for lemon and orange dish wash bars. Large Vix lettering and Bengali product text remain central, with citrus and plate imagery identifying the product at a glance.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The horizontal format uses the brand as a strong left-to-center anchor. Radiating highlights, bright citrus slices and saturated variant colors add energy while keeping the two packs visually related.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Lemon bar: green wrapper with a citrus slice and white plate imagery. Orange bar: orange wrapper with matching citrus graphics and the same bilingual hierarchy.

gallery.caption: Lemon bar: green wrapper with a citrus slice and white plate imagery.
Orange bar: orange wrapper with matching citrus graphics and the same bilingual hierarchy.

title: Mr. Glasso — Glass Cleaner
desc: A glass-cleaner label system presented on a trigger spray and refill bottle. Blue liquid, white label areas and reflective surface imagery create a clear connection to the cleaning category.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: Both containers retain the same red-accented wordmark and cool blue visual language. The label adapts to each bottle silhouette while maintaining recognisable brand placement.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Trigger spray: a blue-and-white spray head above a compact front label with glass-cleaning imagery. Refill bottle: a blue screw cap and taller curved container carry the related label treatment.

gallery.caption: Trigger spray: a blue-and-white spray head above a compact front label with glass-cleaning imagery.
Refill bottle: a blue screw cap and taller curved container carry the related label treatment.

title: J-Flush — Toilet Cleaner
desc: A toilet-cleaner packaging presentation using a deep blue angled-neck bottle and red cap. The front label combines a prominent product title with a lighter blue center and a dark information panel.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The label follows the tapered front of the container. Red-and-white title treatment separates the brand from the blue bottle, while the angled neck remains visually unobstructed.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Front bottle view: blue body, red angled cap and a vertically organized label designed around the curved container.

gallery.caption: Front bottle view: blue body, red angled cap and a vertically organized label designed around the curved container.

title: Orbit Nova — HD40 & HD50
desc: A coordinated heavy-duty lubricant packaging family across 1L, 3L and 5L containers. Blue bottles and a repeated angular label system connect the HD40 and HD50 variants.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The white upper field prioritises the Orbit brand, Nova name and viscosity grade. Dark lower panels, truck imagery and orange accents create a consistent hierarchy across compact bottles and handled containers.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Nova HD40 1L: a compact blue bottle with a white angled header, orange HD40 lettering and a truck image. Nova HD50 1L: the companion SAE 50 label retains the same blue-and-orange visual system. Nova HD50 3L: the label expands to a handled bottle while preserving the central name and grade hierarchy. Nova HD40 5L: a larger blue handled container with a broad white upper panel and dark truck illustration. Nova HD50 5L: the SAE 50 variant adapts the same family layout to the 5L format.

gallery.caption: Nova HD40 1L: a compact blue bottle with a white angled header, orange HD40 lettering and a truck image.
Nova HD50 1L: the companion SAE 50 label retains the same blue-and-orange visual system.
Nova HD50 3L: the label expands to a handled bottle while preserving the central name and grade hierarchy.
Nova HD40 5L: a larger blue handled container with a broad white upper panel and dark truck illustration.
Nova HD50 5L: the SAE 50 variant adapts the same family layout to the 5L format.

title: Orbit XPower — Motorcycle Oil Range
desc: A four-variant motorcycle-oil label system presented on white 1L bottles. The collection uses consistent orange diagonal graphics and a motorcycle image, with viscosity grades providing the main point of differentiation.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: A restrained white background keeps the technical grade prominent. The Orbit brand, XPower name and large grade sit above the motorcycle illustration, with supporting specifications organised along the bottom.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: 10W30: oversized gray grade text, orange diagonal strokes and a motorcycle illustration on a white bottle. 10W40: the grade changes within the same structured label composition. 20W40: consistent orange accents and technical information maintain family recognition. 20W50: the fourth viscosity variant completes the shared white-and-orange presentation.

gallery.caption: 10W30: oversized gray grade text, orange diagonal strokes and a motorcycle illustration on a white bottle.
10W40: the grade changes within the same structured label composition.
20W40: consistent orange accents and technical information maintain family recognition.
20W50: the fourth viscosity variant completes the shared white-and-orange presentation.

title: Orbit RevX — ATF DEX III
desc: A red 1L transmission-fluid packaging presentation. Large RevX lettering and an ATF DEX III band establish the product hierarchy above a dark automotive gear-selector image.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: White upper label space separates the Orbit brand from the red bottle. A black lower panel and diagonal transition give the technical product a distinctive appearance within the wider range.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: RevX 1L: red bottle, white brand panel, bold ATF band and a black automotive imagery field.

gallery.caption: RevX 1L: red bottle, white brand panel, bold ATF band and a black automotive imagery field.

title: Orbit BoostX — CNG Engine Oil
desc: A 2L CNG engine-oil packaging design on a gold handled container. Orange BoostX lettering and a green-and-white label connect the product name, viscosity grade and vehicle illustration.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The wide white upper field gives the brand and product name clear separation. Curved green graphics and a CNG vehicle image distinguish this application from the truck and motorcycle ranges.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: BoostX 2L: gold container with orange title, 20W50 grade, green accents and a CNG vehicle illustration.

gallery.caption: BoostX 2L: gold container with orange title, 20W50 grade, green accents and a CNG vehicle illustration.

title: Orbit Supreme — Passenger Car Oil
desc: A 4L passenger-car oil presentation on a white handled container. Blue Supreme typography, a prominent 20W50 grade and a car illustration form the key visual hierarchy.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The white bottle supports a clean label with flowing blue graphics. The product grade sits on the left, balanced by the car image and darker blue detail area on the right.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Supreme 4L: white container, blue-and-white label, large 20W50 grade and passenger-car imagery.

gallery.caption: Supreme 4L: white container, blue-and-white label, large 20W50 grade and passenger-car imagery.

title: Orbit Elite HDE — 15W40
desc: A heavy-duty engine-oil label on a gold 5L container. Red and gray Elite HDE typography sits above a 15W40 grade and a truck illustration.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: The label uses a white upper area for identity and technical information, transitioning into a deep red lower section. Curved highlights and truck imagery add motion within the gold container silhouette.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Elite HDE 5L: gold bottle, red-and-gray name, prominent 15W40 grade and a white truck above a red graphic base.

title: Orbit Optima HDE — 20W50
desc: A gold 5L heavy-duty engine-oil packaging presentation for Optima HDE. The design pairs a clear 20W50 grade with red accents, a white brand field and a truck illustration.

caseStudy.title: Visual direction
caseStudy.text: A familiar white-to-red composition connects this pack to the heavy-duty range, while the Optima name and viscosity grade distinguish the variant. The truck anchors the lower-right label area.

caseStudy.title: Design details
caseStudy.text: Optima HDE 5L: gold handled container with a white header, red lower panel and truck-led visual composition.
